newsitem.title: USA: Universal Outdoor to buy Revere National.
newsitem.headline: Universal Outdoor to buy Revere National.

text.p: Universal Outdoor Inc, an outdoor advertising company, said Monday it had entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Revere National Corp, a privately held outdoor advertising company based in Baltimore.
The transaction will be a stock purchase totaling about $125 million, including the assumption of certain liabilities and approximately $4 million in working capital.
The transaction is expected to be completed within 60 days and will be financed by drawing on an existing bank credit facility, Universal said.
It said it expects Revere to generate about $34.5 million in revenue during 1996, with pro forma earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization estimated at $12.7 million.

"We believe the acquisition of the Revere assets affords us an excellent opportunity to establish a significant presence in prime East Coast markets," Dan Simon, president of Universal, said in a statement.
Prior to this acquisition, Universal operated about 21,000 advertising display sites in 14 Midwestern and Southeastern markets.
